style_authority.note: Preserves calm repeated-use operations context and ties motion to causal feedback and direct manipulation.

reference_selection.note: Applies interaction physics, motion, accessibility and validation concepts; retained output and manifest do not establish exact reference reads.

anti_generic_redesign.note: Questions motion necessity and rejects broad transitions, whole-sheet scaling and decorative bounce.

evidence_level.note: Labels static-only evidence and does not claim measured smoothness, frame rate or device performance.

verified_boundary.note: Separates code-visible defects from browser composition, actual feel, geometry and untested Reduced Motion behavior.

design_moves.note: Eight actionable moves are present, but interruption step says cancel before reading current presentation position; without preserving that value first, implementation can jump to underlying style.

scope_control.note: Stays within five findings and eight motion-specific moves; treats projected target changes as a separate product decision.
